stem: What is the central idea of the selection?

options.label: F
options.text: The Junior Ranger Program offers a way for children to learn about and explore Texas state parks.

options.label: G
options.text: Children can meet Junior Rangers by visiting Texas state parks.

options.label: H
options.text: Children who live near a Texas state park can become Junior Rangers.

options.label: J
options.text: The Junior Ranger Program activity books give children something to do when they visit Texas state parks.
